---

## SCUE Audio Analysis Data — Comprehensive Exploration Report

### 1. SCUE Agents & Architecture Overview

**SCUE** (Spatial Cue Engine) is a 5-layer + frontend system for automated lighting/laser/visual cue generation during live DJ sets. The system analyzes audio tracks offline, tracks live playback via Pioneer hardware, generates semantic music events, maps to effects, and outputs control signals to hardware.

**Layer Structure:**
- **Layer 0:** Beat-Link Bridge (Java subprocess → WebSocket → Python adapter) — real-time Pro DJ Link protocol
- **Layer 1:** Track Analysis & Live Tracking (offline analysis + real-time cursor)
- **Layer 2:** Cue Generation (music events → semantic cues)
- **Layer 3:** Effect Engine (semantic cues → abstract visual output)
- **Layer 4:** Output & Hardware (abstract → DMX/OSC/MIDI + venue config)
- **Frontend:** React 19 + TypeScript (Zustand, TanStack Query, Vite, Tailwind)

---

### 2. Audio Analysis Data Architecture

#### **2.1 Data Models (Python Dataclasses)**

The canonical data structure is `TrackAnalysis` in `/Users/brach/Documents/THE_FACTORY/projects/DjTools/scue/scue/layer1/models.py`:

```
TrackAnalysis:
  ├── Fingerprint & metadata
  │   ├── fingerprint: str (SHA256)
  │   ├── audio_path: str
  │   ├── title, artist, duration
  │
  ├── Beatgrid (Tier 0)
  │   ├── bpm: float
  │   ├── beats: list[float] (seconds)
  │   ├── downbeats: list[float] (seconds)
  │   └── beatgrid_source: "analysis" | "pioneer_enriched"
  │
  ├── Tier 1 — Section Segmentation
  │   └── sections: list[Section]
  │       ├── label: "intro" | "verse" | "build" | "drop" | "breakdown" | "fakeout" | "outro"
  │       ├── start: float (seconds)
  │       ├── end: float (seconds)
  │       ├── confidence: float (0.0–1.0)
  │       ├── bar_count: int
  │       ├── expected_bar_count: int
  │       ├── irregular_phrase: bool
  │       ├── fakeout: bool
  │       ├── original_label: str
  │       └── source: "analysis" | "pioneer_enriched"
  │
  ├── Tier 2 — Event Detection
  │   ├── events: list[MusicalEvent]
  │   │   ├── type: str (kick | snare | hihat | clap | riser | faller | stab | arp_note)
  │   │   ├── timestamp: float (seconds)
  │   │   ├── duration: float | None
  │   │   ├── intensity: float (0.0–1.0)
  │   │   └── payload: dict
  │   │
  │   └── drum_patterns: list[DrumPattern]
  │       ├── bar_start, bar_end: int
  │       ├── kick, snare, clap: list[int] (16 slots per bar)
  │       ├── hihat_type: "8ths" | "16ths" | "offbeat" | "roll" | "none"
  │       ├── hihat_density: float
  │       ├── hihat_open_ratio: float
  │       └── confidence: float
  │
  ├── Tier 3 — Track-Level Features
  │   └── features: TrackFeatures
  │       ├── energy_curve: list[float] (downsampled RMS, ~0.5s per value)
  │       ├── mood: str (dark | euphoric | melancholic | aggressive | neutral)
  │       ├── danceability: float (0.0–1.0)
  │       ├── key: str (e.g. "Cm", "F#m", "Ab")
  │       ├── key_confidence: float (0.0–1.0)
  │       └── key_source: "analysis" | "pioneer_enriched"
  │
  ├── RGB Waveform
  │   └── waveform: RGBWaveform | None
  │       ├── sample_rate: int (frames per second, default 60)
  │       ├── duration: float (track duration in seconds)
  │       ├── low: list[float] (bass, 0–250 Hz, normalized 0.0–1.0)
  │       ├── mid: list[float] (mids, 250 Hz–4 kHz)
  │       └── high: list[float] (highs, 4 kHz+)
  │
  └── Versioning & Enrichment
      ├── version: int
      ├── source: str
      ├── created_at: float
      ├── pioneer_bpm: float | None
      ├── pioneer_key: str | None
      ├── pioneer_beatgrid: list[float] | None
      ├── rekordbox_id: int | None
      └── enrichment_timestamp: float | None
```

#### **2.2 Live Playback Cursor (Layer 1B)**

`TrackCursor` — the Layer 1 → Layer 2 interface:

```
TrackCursor:
  ├── current_section: SectionInfo
  │   ├── label, start_time, end_time
  │   ├── bar_count, expected_bar_count
  │   ├── progress: float (0.0–1.0)
  │   ├── confidence: float
  │   ├── irregular_phrase, fakeout: bool
  │   └── source: "analysis" | "pioneer_enriched"
  │
  ├── next_section: SectionInfo | None
  │
  ├── upcoming_events: list[MusicalEvent]
  │   (time-adjusted for current BPM)
  │
  ├── current_features: TrackCursorFeatures
  │   ├── energy: float (0.0–1.0, interpolated)
  │   ├── mood: str
  │   └── danceability: float
  │
  └── beat_position: BeatPosition
      ├── beat_in_bar: int (1–4)
      ├── bar_in_section: int
      ├── is_downbeat: bool
      ├── bpm: float (effective, pitch-adjusted)
      ├── original_bpm: float
      └── timestamp: float (wall clock)
```

Plus `PlaybackState`

Now here's the thorough inventory. The spec lives at `enable/audio-data/docs/DATA_SPEC.md` — the full package structure is at `enable/audio-data/`.

## What agents need — summary by category

**1. Pre-Show (Offline) — 11 categories:**

- **Identity & Metadata** — fingerprint, title, artist, duration, rekordbox_id, genre, color, play_count, etc.
- **Beatgrid & Tempo** — BPM, beat timestamps, downbeats, time signature, tempo stability, first beat offset
- **Section Structure** — labeled sections (intro/verse/build/drop/breakdown/fakeout/outro) with bar counts, phrase regularity, confidence, energy deltas
- **Musical Events** — kick, snare, hihat, clap, riser, faller, stab, arp_note, vocal_chop, impact, sweeps, silence markers
- **Drum Patterns** — 16th-note grid per bar, hihat type/density, swing, pattern fingerprints for cross-track matching
- **Track Features** — energy curve, mood, danceability, key + confidence, spectral centroid/flux/loudness curves, frequency balance
- **RGB Waveform** — 3-band (low/mid/high) at 60fps for visualization
- **Stems** — paths to Demucs-separated drums/bass/vocals/other + model metadata
- **Cue Points** — Pioneer hot cues, memory points, loops with colors and labels
- **Phrase Analysis** — Pioneer ANLZ phrase boundaries with kind/mood IDs
- **Ableton Context** — tempo, clips, automation, effect chains from .als files

**2. Enrichment (Pioneer merge) —** BPM override, beatgrid override, key, cues, phrases, plus a full divergence log of what differed

**3. Live Performance (real-time cursor) —** beat position, playback state, section progress, upcoming events, interpolated energy/mood, and multi-deck mix context (crossfader, channel faders, transition detection)

**4. What's missing today** — stem separation (M7 blocker), drum/riser events, vocal presence, DJM mixer state, spectral curves, cross-library pattern matching

The spec has every field typed and sourced. The gaps table at the bottom shows what to build next and what blocks it.

    19→
    20→### beat-link MetadataFinder returns wrong metadata on XDJ-AZ (and all Device Library Plus hardware)
    21→Date: 2026-03-16
    22→Updated: 2026-03-20
    23→Context: Building the Java bridge JAR. Testing with Pioneer XDJ-AZ all-in-one DJ unit.
    24→Problem: Track metadata (title, artist) from MetadataFinder is incorrect after the first track load per player. BPM from CdjStatus is always correct. The XDJ-AZ uses Device Library Plus (DLP) format (`exportLibrary.db`) with a different ID namespace than legacy `export.pdb`. When MetadataFinder uses the DLP ID to query CrateDigger's DeviceSQL data, it retrieves the wrong record. Confirmed known issue: beat-link-trigger's CHANGELOG states the XDJ-AZ always uses Device Library Plus IDs.
    25→Fix: Use the `rbox` Python library to read metadata directly from the USB's `exportLibrary.db`, bypassing beat-link's metadata system entirely. Use beat-link only for real-time playback data (BPM, pitch, beat position, on-air, beat events). See ADR-012 in DECISIONS.md.
    26→Prevention: Any time new Pioneer hardware is supported, check whether it uses DLP or legacy DeviceSQL. Affected hardware: XDJ-AZ, Opus Quad, OMNIS-DUO, CDJ-3000X.
    27→**UPDATE 2026-03-20:** beat-link 8.1.0-SNAPSHOT (used by latest BLT) has added XDJ-AZ support. The XDJ-AZ dbserver WORKS — unlike Opus Quad, it has a functioning dbserver port. CrateDigger can download exportLibrary.db over NFS from XDJ-AZ and use it for ID translation. The DLP ID mismatch appears to be resolved in v8.1.0-SNAPSHOT. When this version releases, we should reassess ADR-012 — beat-link's native metadata path may work for XDJ-AZ without our rbox workaround. See `research/findings-xdj-az-blt-metadata-2026-03.md` for full analysis.
    28→
    29→### XDJ-AZ track change detection: trackType does NOT transition through NO_TRACK
    30→Date: 2026-03-16"}]}
